```{r}
#loading data
df <- gapminder::gapminder_unfiltered

```


```{r}
df |>
  group_by(country) |>
  filter(lifeExp == max(lifeExp)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(year, country, lifeExp) |>
  arrange(year) -> 
  sumdat

```
